items.title: 693. What’s Our Job as Humans Anymore?
items.content_html:
It may just be being human. Stephen Dubner interviews A.I. performer Tilly Norwood to find out if we are as replaceable as we fear. (Part two of a two-part series.) SOURCES: Sean Astin, actor, president of SAG-AFTRA. Kevin Kelly, co-founder of Wired. Ethan Mollick, associate professor of management at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania. Tilly Norwood, A.I. performer. Eline Van der Velden, founder and C.E.O. of Particle6.

Source: Freakonomics Radio · 2026-10-30

Tags: #经济 #思考
